authority: User preference relayed by root 2026-10-13: conservative forecast from visible state; hidden points not required

currentCheckpoint.stats: Map displayed rank to inclusive minimum threshold as lower bound; upper bound is next threshold minus1 if rank below6, otherwise unknown. Never call minimum exact observed points.
currentCheckpoint.affinity: Unknown current-rank affinity uses lowerBound0 and exactValue=null; current-rank observed readiness may be supplied independently.
currentCheckpoint.history: Current visible baseline suffices; no old walkthrough/action history required.
currentCheckpoint.relationship: Unknown preparation or relationship route is not automatically absent, unstarted, normal, or friendship.

forecast.statActions: Only verified base gain under all applicable guards; temporary nonnegative bonus may be ignored per stat_lower_bound_adapter_contract.json.
forecast.dialogue: Use only selected path or explicitly declared future-answer policy. Unknown actual answers do not inherit the maximum.
forecast.affinityBonuses: Do not assume matching Persona, Charm or examination bonuses; ignore them in guaranteed lower-bound forecasts.
forecast.ordinaryMeeting: No numeric lower-bound increment is invented. Reserve a guarded adaptive checkpoint; observe rank-up availability, actual meeting type and next readiness.
forecast.unknownReadiness: May suggest inspection/meeting checkpoint, never require player to supply hidden raw affinity.
